name: zvid_image_blit_to_active_target
description: zVid_Image::BlitToActiveTarget routes surfaced images on the active primary framebuffer through the DirectDraw primary blit helper and otherwise dispatches through the selected source-to-primary callback.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48f500 compares image->surface against zero, compares zRndr::g_frameBuffer with zVideo::GetPrimarySurfacePixels(), calls zVideo_buff::BltSourceToPrimaryClipped with clipFlags masked to 16 bits for the primary DirectDraw path, and otherwise tail-dispatches through g_zVideo_pfnBltSourceToPrimary with the original clipFlags.

The native smoke installs a fake primary DirectDraw surface and selected blit callback, verifies the surfaced active-primary path calls DirectDraw Blt through zVideo_buff::BltSourceToPrimaryClipped with the expected clipped rectangles and source-color-key flags, then changes the active framebuffer and verifies fallback dispatch preserves image, coordinates, full clipFlags, and source rect.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?BlitToActiveTarget@zVid_Image@@YIXPAUzVidImagePartial@@HHHPAUzVidRect32@@@Z produced zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x48f500 after masking 16 relocation bytes and trimming 5 trailing VC5 NOP bytes via python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x48f500.
